cpu_contract: 24 dense-versus-ranked synthetic score cases over2 rows x4 primed states, plus3 audited micro-control steps testing rejection rollback and EOS. No model weights or GPU.
cpu_pass_rule: 24/24 identical selections, EOS/rollback/audits pass, max synthetic selector call<0.2s. Not a model speed/quality claim.
